## Decisions
- Package name: `offgrid-ai` (unscoped, was @eeshans/offgrid-ai initially)
- Install method: curl installer is primary; npm is secondary for devs with Node
- No Homebrew distribution (too much overhead)
- npm publish: tag-based CI (`git tag v0.2.2 && git push origin v0.2.2`)
- All backends install via Homebrew only — no pip/Python (Ollama, LM Studio via cask, oMLX via tap)
- Three commands: `offgrid-ai`, `status`, `stop`, plus `uninstall`, `version`, `help`
- NPM_TOKEN set as GitHub secret for CI workflow
- Old @eeshans/offgrid-ai package unpublished from npm
- Tart VM pattern: `tart clone tahoe-base tahoe-test` → test → `tart stop tahoe-test && tart delete tahoe-test`

## Architecture
### Modules (13 source files):
- src/config.mjs (101 lines) — paths, binary discovery, config load/save
- src/json.mjs (15 lines) — shared JSON read/write
- src/gguf.mjs (69 lines) — binary GGUF metadata reader
- src/autodetect.mjs (112 lines) — auto-detect capabilities from GGUF
- src/scan.mjs (77 lines) — multi-dir GGUF model scanner
- src/estimate.mjs (112 lines) — memory estimation from GGUF metadata
- src/backends.mjs (118 lines) — backend defs (llama-cpp, mtp, ollama, omlx)
- src/profiles.mjs (164 lines) — profile CRUD with JSON commands
- src/process.mjs (174 lines) — server start/stop/ready with binary discovery
- src/harness-pi.mjs (139 lines) — Pi-only harness sync
- src/logs.mjs (41 lines) — friendly log tailing
- src/ui.mjs (68 lines) — @clack/prompts + picocolors (dead code removed)
- src/cli.mjs (~700 lines) — command router, onboarding, models, run, stop, status, uninstall

### Key infrastructure files:
- bin/offgrid-ai.mjs — entry point (shebang)
- install.sh — curl-based installer script
- scripts/privacy-gate.mjs — 4-gate check (tracked files, user paths, tarball content, secrets)
- scripts/release-check.sh — full release pipeline (git status → privacy → pack → smoke → auth → manual)
- .github/workflows/ci.yml — test on push, auto-publish on tag
- .npmignore — excludes PLAN.md, Dockerfile, test-clean.sh, .pi/, test/
- internal-docs/PLAN.md — product plan
- internal-docs/e2e-testing.md — Tart VM testing instructions
